title: Change F NDE 9169
content: It happened when I was playing kickball in school's sports field. I was unconscious after I fell over. The next thing I knew, I was out of my body. I experienced a dimensional shift while my body was unresponsive. My soul was hovering in the sky and watching classmates get together around my body before I woke up. I still vividly remember one of my classmates who pinched my philtrum and what they discussed about my incident. I would have died if I had mass brain hemorrhage, or if my brain swelled enough to cause all the brain cells to die. As for my experience, it seemed like I was getting closer and closer to the ground while playing kickball. Then, I was moving at a lighting, high-speed. I did my best to comprehend what was happening as I traveled through a tunnel. I watched the smiling faces of my classmates that rotate one slide after another like many pieces of shuttered mirrors. (I still clearly remember three of their faces today) I had trouble breathing and my body was in so much pain. Still, the whole experience continued until I reached the end of the dark tunnel. The light became brighter as all the pictures disappeared. I felt myself moving toward the light at a high speed. Once I entered the light, I found myself floating into a very peaceful state in the black universe. I was formless; like water evaporating and then dispersing slowly. I was very relaxed, peaceful, and comfortable. I could not get enough of this serene feeling. As I write this, I still can experience that state of relaxation. Abruptly, I again experienced what seemed like a dimensional shift in the movie. My soul was floating up above the school sports field. My spirit was up in the air watching my body lying on the grass with all the classmates around me. One of them tried to resuscitate me with a pinch on my philtrum. (the area above the mouth) I lost all the memories from the fall after I woke up. I could not recognize the people around me, and didn't know where the restroom was in the school. Gradually, I recovered my memories after an hour. I could barely walked home with my vague memories two hours later. The above description is still crystal clear to me as I could remember it as now. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: March 2002 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain Accident Direct head injury. How do you consider the content of your experience? Both pleasant AND distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I regained consciousness through a pinch on the philtrum by a classmate who also performed an acupuncture point on me at the same time. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness. The same, no change. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? During the experience. Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Time seemed to go faster or slower than usual. Time was very fast while in the tunnel. Once I got out of the tunnel, it felt like time ceased. Were your senses More vivid than usual? Incredibly more vivid Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. The same. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Became weaker but still could hear. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes. I was moving at a lighting, high-speed. I did my best to comprehend what was happening as I traveled through a tunnel. I watched the smiling faces of my classmates that rotate one slide after another like many pieces of shuttered mirrors. (I still clearly remember three of their faces today) the whole experience continued until I reached the end of the dark tunnel. The light became brighter as all the pictures disappeared. I felt myself moving toward the light at a high speed. Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes Classmates’ faces. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes The whole experience continued until I travelled through the dark tunnel and reached towards the light. All the images disappeared, I felt myself at a high speed heading toward the light. But once I arrived in the light, I found myself floating into a universe where its surroundings were pitch black. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm. Right after I entered the light, I found myself floating into a universe where its surroundings were pitch black. And yet I was formless which I was. I found myself like water evaporated then dispersed slowly. I was very relaxing, peaceful, and comfortable (at this moment, I still could experience that state of relaxation) What emotions did you feel during the experience? It changed from oppressive pain to pleasure and relaxing comfort. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? My past flashed before me, out of my control The memories were projected like broken pieces and playing on a small screen. Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will. I was still enjoying that blissfulness and still not getting enough of it. Suddenly, it was like a dimensional shift in the movie that I was floating up the sports field in school. While my soul was up in the air, I saw my body laid on the grass. I was surrounded by my classmates and one of them who tried to revive me using the Acupuncture pressure point on my philtrum. I heard what they were talking about my accident. God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Unaffiliated- Atheist Unaffiliated- Atheist Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No. I believed in the existence of different dimensions, and believed in the reincarnation of soul in alternated time and space. What is your religion now? Other faiths- Unitarian and other liberal faiths I believe in the existence of God (the spirits of the mystic and nature) , but I don’t believe in religious dogma. Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I studied physics (astrophysics, quantum mechanics, relativity, etc.) Chinese medicine (acupuncture, herbal medicine, philosophical laws). I believe in the existence of different time and space, and the reincarnation of the soul in alternate time and space (non-religious though). Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? No Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? Yes Until the light at the end of the dark tunnel gets closer and closer, the sense of the picture disappears, and I feel like a speed of light running toward the light source. But as soon as I entered the light, I found that it was as if I was floating into the universe, and the surrounding was pitch black. However, my body was already invisible, and I slowly drifted away like water vapor. It was very relaxed, very peaceful, and very comfortable (at this moment, I still could experience that state of relaxation) During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? No What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Moderate changes in my life I studied physics (astrophysics, quantum mechanics, relativity, etc.) Chinese medicine (acupuncture, herbal medicine, philosophical laws). I believe in the existence of different time and space, and the reincarnation of the soul in alternate time and space (non-religious though). Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No Yes After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes Occasionally I will remember some memories (but it actually will happen in the future.) Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Death itself is a process from pain to euphoria and then relief to peace and calm. It is also a journey of crossing over between the dimensions and recycling. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I shared this experience with friends, family, and classmates, but they just thought they were listening to a story. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. This experience absolutely had happened, but I was confused and not knowing what it was. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real. I tried to understand the process of this experience. Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? Yes

environment.environment_other_detail: Entered the light and then was "floating into a very peaceful state in the black universe" with "surroundings ... pitch black."

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Abrupt "dimensional shift" back to hovering above the sports field and then waking after a classmate pinched the philtrum (acupressure point).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Direct head injury from falling while playing kickball at school.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Classmates' faces rotating "like many pieces of shuttered mirrors" during the tunnel; repeated/returned OBE above the sports field before waking.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE above body occurred, then tunnel to light/black universe; later an abrupt "dimensional shift" back to an OBE above the sports field before awakening.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: OBE stage recurred (hovering above the sports field/body) after the black-universe/light phase.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Tunnel imagery included rotating slides of living classmates' smiling faces "like many pieces of shuttered mirrors."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Once I entered the light, I found myself floating into a very peaceful state in the black universe. I was formless; like water evaporating and then dispersing slowly.”
